version.changelog: Fix display name to Google Play Public Data API; keep the canonical slug and Setup onboarding.

llm.summary: This skill is a documented, read-only wrapper for a public Google Play data API and does not include hidden execution, persistence, or credential-stealing behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires network access to https://api.replynodes.com and a ReplyNodes bearer API key, which is proportionate to the API-integration purpose but should be handled as a paid credential.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only; no executable scripts, dependencies, installers, hooks, or automatic runtime setup were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to explicit API calls, bounded pagination and input validation, and repeatedly prohibit Google credentials, cookies, OAuth sessions, catalog enumeration, publishing, and write operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, local profile access, or modification of agent behavior is requested or implemented.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to query public Android app data through ReplyNodes, and the documented capabilities are read-only GET requests for app metadata, search, reviews, permissions, availability, and related public store data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust ReplyNodes with the specific public Google Play queries you send and store REPLYNODES_API_KEY only in a secret or environment variable. Watch prepaid-credit usage for batches and keep caller-side limits on reviews or list operations.
llm.findings:
[YR1] unexpected: The matched text is a safety denial stating the skill never uses cookies, OAuth sessions, publishing paths, catalog enumeration, or write operations; artifact review does not support an information-stealer finding.
[E1] expected: The external URL is the documented ReplyNodes API endpoint used for the skill's core function; the skill discloses the destination and instructs users to keep the API key out of prompts, logs, URLs, and reports.
